findings.rationale: Core-adjacent output schema. The README bill schema said id plus the figures were 'all integers' and instruction.md said every README key is compared as a JSON integer, while the agreement schema, run.py and the verifier keep id a string. README now gives id as 'the agreement's id string, as given' and limits 'all integers' to the figures; instruction.md says the branch and each id are compared as the strings given, every other figure as a JSON integer. The verifier already enforced this; the numeric-id-as-integer mutant (id '0' in order_and_totals) is rejected on test_bill_order_and_file_totals.

gate.rule: declared output types: every 'all integers'/'as JSON integer' umbrella must exempt the string keys it lists (id, branch)

findings.rationale: Core (rule 3.3 applies to every refuelling rental). traps_combined now bills C5 (1 min, 8->7 eighths, the report's exact case: fuel_charge 2100, total 7513), C6 (30 min, 5->2, turnover), C7 (10 h, 8->0, rate 0) and C8 (1,439 min, 1->0). The fee scoped to day rentals, to an hour or more, or to ten hours or more each fails test_figures_left_to_todays_code_together.

gate.rule: combined-condition coverage: every governed rule is graded on each silent-branch input class it can meet (sub-hour, sub-day) in the combined family

findings.rationale: Core (rule 3.2 on the day charged). traps_combined now bills C4 (59 min, 151 miles: mileage_charge 30, total 5445, the report's case), C6 (30 min, 400 miles over a turnover), C7 (10 h, 151 miles at rate 1) and C8 (1,439 min, exactly 150). A zero mileage charge under an hour or under a day, and turnover only on day rentals, each fail.
